告：

一、經濟環境形勢回顧                     I.    ANALYSIS ON ECONOMIC
                                     LANDSCAPE
   二 零 二 五 年，中 國 房 地 產 行 業 仍         In 2025, China’s real estate industry remained to face
   面臨市場信心修復與發展轉型雙                    the dual challenges of market confidence restoration and
   重挑戰，居民購房投資消費意願偏                   developmental transformation. The willingness of residents
   弱，使得房地產企業在資金回籠、                   to invest and consume in home purchases remained weak,
   項目去化、轉型發展等方面均面臨                   placing tremendous pressure on real estate enterprises
   巨大的壓力。                            in terms of capital recovery, project clearance, and
                                     transformational development.

   從政策環境看，二零二五年整體宏                   From the perspective of the policy environment, the
   觀政策環境仍較為寬鬆，同時，住                   overall macro-policy landscape in 2025 remained relatively
   建 部 進 一 步 宣 導「好 房 子」政 策，          accommodative. Concurrently, MOHURD has further
   二 零 二 五 年「好 房 子」政 策 首 次 被         promoted the “quality homes ( 好 房 子 )” policy. In 2025,
   寫入政府工作報告，推動行業告別                   the “quality homes” policy was incorporated into the
   粗放式規模擴張模式、向精細化、                   Report on the Work of the Government for the first time,
   高品質、多元化發展轉型。                      propelling the industry to move away from an extensive
                                     scale expansion model and transition towards refined, high-
                                     quality, and diversified development.

  從 行 業 需 求 看，隨 著「好 房 子」政            From the perspective of industry demand, guided by the
  策引導，客戶對於房屋的需求已從                    “quality homes( 好 房 子 )” policy, customer demand for
  「有 房 住」向「住 好 房」轉 變，對 於             housing has shifted from the concept of “having a place to
  房屋品質、地段區位、功能設計、                    live” to “living in a quality home”. Customers have created
  居住環境、配套設施以及物業服務                    rising and more stringent requirements for housing quality,
  等方面提出了更高、更嚴苛的要求。                   location, functional design, living environment, supporting
                                     facilities, and property management services.

   從競爭格局看，房地產行業競爭格                   From the perspective of competitive landscape, the
   局 已 深 度 調 整，市 場 資 源 加 速 向         competitive dynamics of the real estate industry have
   財務穩健、佈局優質的企業集中，                   undergone profound adjustments. Market resources are
   千億房企數量大幅縮減，頭部房企                   accelerating their concentration towards enterprises with
   市場份額進一步提升。                        sound financial positions and quality layout. The number
                                     of enterprises achieving over RMB100 billion in sales has
                                     significantly decreased, while the market share of leading
                                     real estate enterprises has further increased.

市場回顧                                         MARKET REVIEW
二 零 二 五 年，中 國 房 地 產 行 業 仍 面 臨 市              In 2025, China’s real estate industry remained to face the dual
場 信 心 修 復 與 發 展 轉 型 雙 重 挑 戰，居 民              challenges of market confidence restoration and developmental
購 房 投 資 消 費 意 願 偏 弱，使 得 房 地 產 企              transformation. The willingness of residents to invest and consume
業 在 資 金 回 籠、項 目 去 化、轉 型 發 展 等                in home purchases remained weak, placing tremendous pressure
方面均面臨巨大的壓力。                                  on real estate enterprises in terms of capital recovery, project
                                             clearance, and transformational development.

從 政 策 環 境 看，二 零 二 五 年 整 體 宏 觀 政              From the perspective of the policy environment, the overall macro-
策 環 境 仍 較 為 寬 鬆，同 時，住 建 部 進 一                policy landscape in 2025 remained relatively accommodative.
步宣導「好房子」政策，二零二五年「好房                          Concurrently, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural
子」政策首次被寫入政府工作報告，推動                           Development further promoted the “quality homes ( 好 房 子 )”
行 業 告 別 粗 放 式 規 模 擴 張 模 式、向 精 細              policy. In 2025, the “quality homes” policy was incorporated into
化、高品質、多元化發展轉型。                               the Report on the Work of the Government for the first time,
                                             propelling the industry to move away from an extensive scale
                                             expansion model and transition towards refined, high-quality, and
                                             diversified development.

從行業需求看，隨著「好房子」政策引導，                          From the perspective of industry demand, guided by the “quality
客戶對於房屋的需求已從「有房住」向「住                          homes” policy, customer demand for housing has shifted from the
好房」轉變，對於房屋品質、地段區位、                           concept of “having a place to live” to “living in a quality home”.
功 能 設 計、居 住 環 境、配 套 設 施 以 及 物                Customers have created rising and more stringent requirements
業服務等方面提出了更高、更嚴苛的要求。                          for housing quality, location, functional design, living environment,
                                             supporting facilities, and property management services.

從 競 爭 格 局 看，房 地 產 行 業 競 爭 格 局 已              From the perspective of competitive landscape, the competitive
深 度 調 整，市 場 資 源 加 速 向 財 務 穩 健、               dynamics of the real estate industry have undergone profound
佈 局 優 質 的 企 業 集 中，千 億 房 企 數 量 大              adjustments. Market resources are accelerating their concentration
幅縮減，頭部房企市場份額進一步提升。                           towards enterprises with sound financial positions and quality
                                             layout. The number of enterprises achieving over RMB100 billion
                                             in sales has significantly decreased, while the market share of
                                             leading real estate enterprises has further increased.

企業管治文化及價值                         CORPORATE GOVERNANCE CULTURE
                                  AND VALUE
本公司致力確保其事務按照高道德標準                 The Company is committed to ensuring that its affairs are
進 行。這 反 映 了 本 公 司 的 信 念，在 實 現     conducted in accordance with high ethical standards. This reflects
其 長 遠 目 標 的 同 時，必 須 以 誠 信、透 明     its belief that, in the achievement of its long-term objectives, it is
及 問 責 的 方 式 行 事。透 過 如 此 行 事，本     imperative to act with probity, transparency and accountability.
公 司 相 信 股 東 財 富 將 長 期 最 大 化，其 僱   By so acting, the Company believes that Shareholder wealth will
員、與 本 公 司 有 業 務 往 來 的 人 士 及 本 公   be maximised in the long term and that its employees, those with
司營運所在社區將獲得所有利益。                   whom it does business and the communities in which it operates
                                  will all benefit.

企業管治乃董事會指示本集團管理層處                 Corporate governance is the process by which the Board instructs
理 其 事 務 之 程 序，以 確 保 其 目 標 得 以 達   management of the Group to conduct its affairs with a view to
成。董 事 會 致 力 維 持 及 發 展 健 全 的 企 業   ensuring that its objectives are met. The Board is committed to
管治常規，旨在確保：                        maintaining and developing robust corporate governance practices
                                  that are intended to ensure:

—   為股東帶來令人滿意及可持續的回               —    satisfactory and sustainable returns to Shareholders;
    報；

—   與本公司交易的人士的利益獲得保               —    that the interests of those who deal with the Company are
    障；                                 safeguarded;

—   了解及適當管理整體業務風險；                —    that overall business risk is understood and managed
                                       appropriately;

—   提供令客戶滿意的優質產品及服務；              —    the delivery of high-quality products and services to the
    及                                  satisfaction of customers; and

本 集 團 通 過 微 信 公 眾 號、官 網、面 對 面                   The Group conducts surveys with stakeholders through various
訪談、客戶滿意度調查、職工代表大會、                              ways including official WeChat account, official website, face-to-
社交媒體等多種途徑對利益相關方開展                               face interviews, customer satisfaction survey, employees’ meetings
調 研，了 解 其 對 各 項 ESG 議 題 的 關 注 程                 and social media, so as to understand the level of their concerns
度，並 結 合 本 集 團 業 務 發 展 情 況 對 ESG                 in respect of various ESG issues. Based on the Group’s business
議 題 的 重 要 性 進 行 綜 合 性 排 序，由 此 確                 development, the Group has prioritised the materiality of ESG
定年度 ESG 報告的披露重點。2025 年度，                        issues comprehensively to determine the disclosure focus of the
本集團 ESG 議題重要性評估流程如下：                            ESG Report. The Group’s materiality assessment process of ESG
                                                issues for 2025 is illustrated as follows:



 議題識別
 Identification of issues

 結合本集團業務發展特點、行業 ESG 關注重點及宏觀環境，對上一年度 ESG 議題清單進行檢視與更新。
 Combining the characteristics of the Group’s business development, industry ESG focus and the macro-
 environment, the Group reviews and updates the list of ESG issues from the previous year.


 溝通調研
 Communication survey

 通過訪談等形式，對內外部利益相關方的需求和期望進行深入了解與收集。
 Through methods such as interviews, the Group gains an in-depth understanding of and collects the needs and
 expectations of both internal and external stakeholders.


 重要性排序
 Materiality priority

 依據溝通和調研結果，從「對利益相關方的重要性」及「對本集團業務的重要性」兩個維度對 ESG 議題進行
 排序，以此確定本報告的披露重點及未來可持續發展的管理重點。
 Based on the communication and research results, ESG issues are prioritised from the two dimensions of
 “materiality to stakeholders” and “materiality to the business development of the Group”. On this basis, the key
 areas of disclosure in the Report and the management focus for future sustainable development are determined.

舉報與查處機制                                          Whistleblowing and Investigation Mechanism
同 時，本 集 團 建 立 多 渠 道 的 廉 政 風 險 舉                  The Group has also established a multi-channel whistleblowing
報 機 制，並 對 舉 報 人 信 息 及 舉 報 內 容 嚴                  mechanism for integrity-related risks. Strict confidentiality is
格保密，嚴格控制舉報事件的知情範圍，                               maintained regarding whistleblower identities and the content
保護舉報人免遭因信息洩露導致的打擊                                of their reports, and access to information concerning reported

其 嚴 重 程 度，對 情 節 嚴 重 的 涉 事 者 作 出                  the Group will conduct a rigorous investigation in accordance
相應處罰，並保留追究其法律責任的權利。                              with internal policies to determine the nature and severity of
                                                 the incident. Those involved in serious violations are subject to

 案例：「風清氣正 345 行動」
 Case:“345 Action for a Clean and Upright Culture（風清氣正 345 行動）”

 2025 年 3 月至 5 月，本集團開展「風清氣正 345 行動」，要求所有員工完成廉潔自律承諾和利益衝突申報，
 並對重要管理人員、關鍵崗位開展廉潔談話和監督。報告期內，本集團共計 2.1 萬名員工完成廉潔自律承諾、
 利益衝突申報。
 From March to May 2025, the Group launched the “345 Action for a Clean and Upright Culture,” requiring all
 employees to pledge commitment to integrity and self-discipline and to declare any conflicts of interest. Integrity
 talks and supervisory reviews were also conducted for key management personnel and employees in critical
 positions. During the reporting period, a total of 21,000 employees of the Group completed the integrity pledge
 and conflict-of-interest declaration.

案例：廉潔「新春第一跑」
Case:“New Year’s First Run（新春第一跑）for Integrity”

2025 年 2 月，為築牢廉潔從業思想防線，推動廉政文化深度融入企業文化，本集團組織 400 多名幹部員工
開展「新春第一跑」活動。該活動將健康運動與廉政教育有機結合，並設置廉政知識競賽環節，涵蓋黨紀
法規、廉潔從業準則等核心內容，讓幹部員工在輕鬆氛圍中學習並掌握廉政知識，為公司高質量發展築牢
紀律保障。
In February 2025, to reinforce the importance of integrity in the workplace and embed it deeper into our
corporate culture, the Group organized over 400 managers and employees to participate in the “New Year’s
First Run” activity. This initiative organically combined healthy exercise with integrity education, and included
a segment featuring an integrity knowledge competition that covered core topics ranging from Party discipline
and regulations to professional integrity standards. This enabled managers and employees to learn and master
integrity knowledge in a relaxed atmosphere, thereby solidifying the disciplinary foundation for the Company’s
high-quality development.

信息安全與隱私保護                                           Information security and privacy protection


                         人員意識強化
                         Enhancing Employee Awareness

                         ✓ 對新入職員工提供信息保密和數據安全培訓，並與之簽署相關保密協議，從源頭強
                           化安全意識。
                           The Group provides training on information confidentiality and data security to new
                           employees, and enters into relevant confidentiality agreements with them, strengthening
                           security awareness from the outset.


                         客戶數據保護
                         Protecting Customer Data

                         ✓ 採用內部線上系統搜集、匯總客戶信息，避免線下紙質版保管不善導致信息外露。
                           An internal online system is utilised to collect and aggregate customer information,
                           avoiding information disclosure incidents caused by poor storage of offline paper-based
                           materials.

                         ✓ 未經嚴格審批同意，不得訪問、調用、流轉各經營附屬公司的客戶信息；信息調用後，
                           必須及時銷毀客戶信息，確保客戶信息安全。
                           Customer information within each operating subsidiary of the Group shall not be
                           accessed, utilised or circulated without strict approval. After the information has been
                           accessed, customer information must be timely destroyed to ensure the security of
                           customer information.


                         數據韌性建設
                         Building Data Resilience

                         ✓ 對重要數據進行定期、多地備份，並通過備份系統自動預警與人工每周核查的形式
                           進行備份檢查，每半年組織一次備份數據恢復演練，確保重要數據備份正常和有效。
                           Regular and multi-site backups of critical data are performed, with the backup inspection
                           combining automated alerts from the backup system and manual weekly inspections. A
                           data recovery drill is conducted every six months to ensure important data is backed up
                           normally and effectively.


                         系統全生命周期安全
                         Ensuring System Lifecycle Security

                         ✓ 信息系統建設前均根據要求確定信息系統安全等級；信息系統上線前均通過安全指
                           標及性能驗證測試。
                           Before the construction of any information system within the Group, the required
                           information system security level is determined according to specifications. Prior to the
                           system being launched, it undergoes security benchmarking and performance validation
                           testing.

 案例：共享 AI 應用實踐經驗 — 房地產業 AI 大模型應用座談會
 Case: Sharing AI Application Insights — Real Estate Industry AI Large Model Application Symposium

 2025 年 7 月，本集團受邀參與中國房地產業協會主辦的「房地產業 AI 大模型應用座談會」。本次會議匯聚
 40 餘家房企及科技企業代表，聚焦 AI 大模型在房地產行業的創新應用，展開深度交流，共同探索房地產
 數字化轉型的前沿實踐與未來路徑。會上，本集團分享了在 AI 戰略規劃、落地場景拓展、智能體建設、數
 據治理體系搭建、業務提效路徑及客戶服務升級等方面的實踐成果與經驗心得，為同行提供參考借鑒，共
 同助力房地產行業高質量發展。

 In July 2025, the Group was invited to participate in the “Real Estate Industry AI Large Model Application
 Symposium” hosted by China Real Estate Association. This event brought together representatives from over 40
 real estate enterprises and technology companies for in-depth discussions focused on innovative applications
 of AI large models in the real estate sector, jointly exploring cutting-edge practices and future pathways for
 digital transformation in the industry. At the symposium, the Group shared its practical achievements and
 insights in areas including AI strategic planning, expansion of application scenarios, AI agent development,
 data governance framework establishment, business efficiency enhancement pathways, and customer service
 upgrades, providing valuable reference for peers and contributing to the high-quality development of the real
 estate industry.

                                                    寧靜住宅
                                                 Tranquil Homes

 建發 · 海晏項目於 2025 年榮膺中國城市科學研究會頒發的寧靜住宅「鉑金級認證」，該認證是目前中國住
 宅健康性能的最高等級認證。作為北京市第一家獲得該認證的項目，建發 · 海晏在聲環境控制領域的卓越
 表現獲得權威認可，其採用 LOW-E 低輻射全超白充氬氣暖邊雙中空夾膠玻璃、PVB、高承重全隱藏式靜音
 五金件、專利隔熱條等隔音材料，並應用局部加厚分戶牆、雙密封條、浮築樓板、保溫隔聲墊等技術，有
 效降低環境噪音影響，營造安靜的生活空間。
 Jianfa · Haiyan Project was honored with the “Platinum Level Certification” for Tranquil Residences in 2025,
 awarded by the Chinese Society for Urban Studies. This certification represents the highest grade for residential
 health performance in China. As the first project in Beijing that has received this certification, Jianfa · Haiyan
 has gained authoritative recognition for its exceptional performance in acoustic environment control. The
 project employs a range of soundproofing materials, including LOW-E ultra-clear tempered argon-filled warm-
 edge double-insulating laminated glass, PVB interlayers, high-load-bearing fully concealed silent hardware and
 patented thermal break strips. Additionally, technologies such as locally thickened partition walls, double-seal
 strips, floating floors and thermal-acoustic insulation pads are applied to effectively mitigate environmental noise
 and create a tranquil living space.

                                                 科技住宅
                                           Tech-Enabled Homes

本集團與華為簽訂戰略合作協議，引進華為鴻蒙智家方案，目前已在北京、廈門、武漢、寧波等 7 個項目
落地。
The Group has entered into a strategic cooperation agreement with Huawei to adopt the Harmony Intelligent
Home Solution. To date, this solution has been implemented in seven of our projects across key cities including
Beijing, Xiamen, Wuhan and Ningbo.

                                          AI 檢測技術

                                                       非遺傳承
                                       Intangible Cultural Heritage Preservation

 本集團活化、傳承非遺精粹，將琺琅、蜀繡、灰塑、東陽木雕等技藝融入建築細節。
 The Group revitalizes and carries forward the essence of intangible cultural heritage, integrating traditional
 crafts such as cloisonné enamel, Shu (literally meaning “Sichuan” in Chinese) embroidery, lime sculpture and
 Dongyang wood carving into architectural details.




                                                      古典園林
                                                  Classical Gardens

 本集團秉承「雖由人作，宛自天開」的造園智慧，並深研需求、科學規劃，構築「多元全齡」的當代生活場景，
 使其擁有「可遊、可居、可賞」特質，打造具有生態價值與人文關懷的園林景觀。
 Guided by the timeless wisdom of creating landscapes that appear “heaven-made though built by man”, the
 Group meticulously researches user needs and plan to construct “diverse and targeting all-age” contemporary
 living spaces, which makes the gardens embody the essence of “being fit for strolling, dwelling and admiring”,
 creating landscapes of both ecological value and humanistic care.

 集團
 The Group

 1. 完善工程技術規定和檢查評價標準，特別是涉及結構安全、生產安全、防滲漏等關鍵環節、關鍵材料，
    能守住底線要求不出錯。
    Improves engineering technical regulations and inspection and evaluation standards, especially for key
    aspects and materials related to structural safety, production safety, and leakage prevention, to ensure that
    bottom line requirements are met without error.

 2. 固化、優化工程現場管理的作業流程（重點施工場平佈置圖的全部推廣），提高生產效率，確保生產有
    序高效，工序、材料管理留痕，可追溯。
    Standardises and optimises the operational procedures of on-site engineering management (with full
    promotion of the key construction site layout plan), to enhance production efficiency, ensure orderly and
    efficient production and maintain traceable records for processes and material management.

 3. 負責建立集團統一的建造體系和推廣（含鋁模、爬架、全砼外牆、薄砌薄抹、工廠流水化精裝等），建
    立相關施工指引。
    Establishes and promotes the Group’s unified construction system (including aluminum formwork, climbing
    frames, full concrete exterior walls, thin masonry and plastering, factory assembly line finishing, etc.), and
    develops relevant construction guidelines.

 4. 負責組織檢查並按月反饋結果，快速準確發現一線的問題，並有效改進。
    Organises inspections and provides monthly feedback on results to promptly and accurately identify frontline
    issues with effective improvements.


 集群
 Cluster

 1. 組織複雜結構項目的結構專項評審，並監督項目按專項評審方案的要求和措施實施，監督涉及到結構
    安全及建發標誌性效果的重要材料採購，提升集群範圍的工程工藝工法。
    Conducts special structure reviews for complex structural projects and supervises the implementation of
    such projects in accordance with the requirements and measures of approved review plans, supervises the
    procurement of critical materials related to structural safety and C&D’s iconic design effects, and enhances
    engineering techniques and construction methods across the cluster.

 2. 確保工程制度、標準、技術規定、建造體系的執行落地。
    Ensures effective implementation of engineering systems, standards, technical specifications and construction
    systems.

 3. 負責共性難點問題的分析，推動解決與提升。
    Analyzes common and challenging problems, driving their resolution and facilitating improvement.

 4. 按照集團標準組織生產、確保關鍵業務點（達售、展示、封頂、竣備、交付）不跑偏，及時預警偏離問
    題並組織資源，解決問題。
    Organises production in accordance with the Group’s standards to ensure critical business milestones
    (reaching saleable condition, display, topping out, completion filing and delivery) stay on track, issues timely
    warnings for any deviations, and mobilize resources to resolve problems.

事業部
Business Division

1. 按集團的工程技術規定及工程策劃會內容，嚴格有序高效組織生產。
   Organises production in a strict, orderly, and efficient manner in accordance with the Group’s engineering
   technical specifications and the content of engineering planning meetings.

2. 加強現場的材料、安文、人員、設備的組織管理，嚴格按圖施工，即材料工序合規有序。
   Strengthens on-site management of materials, workplace safety promotional materials, personnel, and
   equipment, and strictly adheres to the construction drawings, ensuring compliance and orderly execution of
   materials and procedures.

3. 依據工程制度、標準、技術規定及檢查評價辦法按階段做好項目日常巡檢工作。
   Conducts regular project inspections by phase in accordance with engineering policies, standards, technical
   regulations, and inspection and evaluation methods.


城市公司 / 項目部
City Company/Project Division

1. 每天應實時跟進項目生產進度，執行關鍵工序驗收，對生產關鍵節點嚴格把控質量。
   Provides daily real-time updates on project progress, conducts key process acceptance inspection, and
   controls the quality of production stages.

2. 管好材料的應用和工序合規，特別是涉及結構安全及建發產品標誌性的重要材料。
   Ensures proper application of materials and compliance with procedures, particularly for critical materials
   related to structural safety and the iconic features of C&D’s products.

3. 按圖施工，每天比對現場與施工圖的一致性，嚴禁無圖和不按圖施工。
   Ensures construction is carried out according to plans, with daily comparisons between on-site conditions
   and construction drawings, and construction without drawings or non-compliance with drawings are strictly
   prohibited.

                                                    過程評估
                                               Process Assessment

 本集團對施工過程的關鍵階段（展示區及樣板房、基礎、地下室、主體、樣板驗收、批量精裝、景觀等）進
 行工程策劃、施工安全、結構安全、防滲漏、工藝觀感、工序及材料驗收、樣板先行、按圖施工、文明施
 工九個維度檢查。
 The Group conducts inspections of key stages in the construction process, including display areas and display
 units, foundations, basements, main structures, sample inspections, bulk decoration works, and landscaping,
 across nine dimensions, including project planning, construction safety, structural safety, prevention of
 seepage and leakage, workmanship aesthetics, process and material acceptance, model-first implementation,
 construction based on design drawings, and civilised construction.

 2025 年，本集團累計對 158 個項目合計開展 784 次過程評估，採用隨機抽查的方式對項目質量安全進行突
 擊檢查，對重要的結構安全、材料選型、關鍵節點採用即時原則進行實時檢查，以提前發現質量問題並進
 行整改，有效提高產品品質。
 In 2025, the Group carried out an accumulative total of 784 process assessments for 158 projects. On a random
 inspection basis, surprise inspections were conducted on project quality and safety. Real-time inspections were
 conducted on critical aspects such as structural safety, material selection, and key construction milestones, to
 identify quality issues in advance and carry out rectification, thereby effectively enhancing product quality.

                                                交付評估
                                          Delivery Assessment

本集團搭建「9A 交付體系」，在項目交付前聘請專業第三方公司從承諾一致性、產品舒適性、客訴輿情、
建築、景觀、公區、質量、防滲漏、工藝觀感九個維度，對項目進行嚴格的全面檢查，通過多輪次的一房
一驗、物業承接查驗、外窗淋水等專項動作，保證產品安全性和品質。2025 年，本集團累計對 81 個項目
運用「9A 交付體系」進行檢查。
The Group has established the “9A Delivery System”, under which a professional third-party company is
engaged prior to project delivery to conduct thorough and stringent inspections across nine dimensions:
consistency commitment, product comfort, customer complaints and public opinion, architecture, landscaping,
communal areas, quality, prevention of seepage and leakage, and workmanship aesthetics, to ensure product
safety and quality through multiple rounds of specialized inspections, including unit-by-unit checks, property
takeover inspections, and external window water tightness tests. In 2025, the Group applied the “9A Delivery
System” to inspect a total of 81 projects.

在項目交付後 90 天，本集團亦對項目公區的維護、設施設備的運行情況進行定期自查和第三方不定期飛檢，
並自建保修辦團隊，以快速響應業主的維修需求。
Within 90 days after project delivery, the Group also conducts regular internal checks and unscheduled third-
party inspections on the maintenance of communal areas and the operation of facilities and equipment. In
addition, the Group has established its own warranty service teams to respond promptly to repair requests from
property owners.

負責任營銷管理                                             Responsible Marketing Management


                                              營銷責任到人
                        Assigning Marketing Responsibility to Designated Individuals

 • 銷售人員需嚴格按照說辭標準對外輸出，不得誇大和隨意承諾；置業顧問每月底填寫《置業顧問行為底
   線風險排查確認表》，由項目營銷負責人確認；
   Sales personnel are required to strictly adhere to the standardised sales presentations when communicating
   externally, and are prohibited from exaggerating or making arbitrary commitments. Property consultants
   shall complete the “Property Consultant Behavioural Risk Investigation Confirmation Form” by the end of
   each month, which requires confirmation by the project marketing manager;

 • 如營銷招標合同金額超過 10 萬元，則投標人須簽署誠信守法承諾書。
   If the marketing tender contract amount exceeds RMB100,000, bidders are required to sign an undertaking
   of honesty and legal compliance.


                                                    宣傳物料審核
                                             Promotional Materials Review

 • 採取「三審三校」審查流程，嚴格把控宣傳與營銷信息的準確性、真實性與合規性；
   A “Three Reviews and Three Checks” review process is adopted to rigorously ensure the accuracy,
   authenticity, and compliance of promotional and marketing materials;

 • 使用「品牌落地推廣審批系統」加強對一線日常宣傳內容的檢查；
   The “Brand Localisation Promotion Review System” is used to strengthen the inspection of routine
   promotional contents at the frontline business operations;

 • 統一授權方式對各單位官微公眾號、視頻號等平台賬號進行年審管理。
   A unified authorisation approach is adopted to conduct annual reviews and management of official WeChat
   public accounts, video accounts, and other platform accounts of each unit.


                                                     銷售風險排查
                                                Sales Risk Investigation

 • 內部檢查：針對銷售合同文本、銷售物料銷售展示等風險開展不定期開展集團層面、集群層面及事業
   部層面的檢查與抽查；
   Internal Review: Irregular inspections and spot checks are conducted on sales contracts, promotional
   materials, sales displays, etc., at the group, cluster, and business division levels to identify risks;

 • 外部檢查：針對沙盤、樣板房、戶型冊、不利因素、合同、交付前的承諾一致性等進行風險排查和復
   驗閉環。
   External Review: Risk investigations and closed-loop re-verification are conducted on sand tables, display
   units, floor plan brochures, adverse factors, contracts, pre-delivery commitments, and others.

                                             營銷合規監督
                                   Marketing Compliance Supervision

  An annual compliance review is performed based on the Standards for Marketing Inspection and Evaluation,
  the results of which will be linked to the performance appraisal of marketing personnel;

• 定期開展合規營銷的專項審計。
  Special compliance audits of marketing activities are regularly performed.


                                              營銷風險提示
                                         Marketing Risk Warnings

• 對客戶的風險提示：在銷售案場、展示區、樣板房均進行風險提示，同時各項目均在顯目位置展示紅
  線內外不利因素；
  Customer Risk Warnings: Risk warning signs are displayed at sales venues, display areas, and display units.
  Concurrently, factors unfavourable to both inside and outside the red line are prominently displayed at each
  project location;

• 對營銷人員的風險提示：在洽談區設置對銷售人員口頭承諾的風險提示。
  Sales Personnel Risk Warnings: Risk warning signs are set up for sales personnel’s verbal commitments in
  negotiation areas.


                                               第三方暗訪
                                     Third-Party Unannounced Visits

• 由第三方公司每月針對在售項目進行銷售服務暗訪工作，對案場接待禮儀、銷售說辭一致性、銷售物
  料的規範性進行現場識別，及時反饋暗訪結果。
  A third-party company will be appointed to conduct monthly unannounced visits to projects on sales,
  including identifying receptionist etiquette at sales venue, consistency of sales presentations, and compliance
  of promotional materials at the site, and providing timely feedback on the results of such unannounced
  visits.

BIM 技術應用
BIM Technology Application

本集團深化 BIM 技術的全周期應用。在施工圖設計階段，藉助參數化、三維可視手段深化設計，整合建築、
結構、機電等專業模型，提升圖紙的準確性；以此提前發現並解決潛在隱患，規避後期工程返工風險，助
力項目品質與效益雙提升。
The Group deepens the full-cycle application of BIM technology. During the construction drawing design phase,
we utilise parameterisation and 3D visualisation tools to enhance the design process, integrating professional
models such as architecture, structure, and Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing (MEP) to improve drawing
accuracy. This allows us to identify and address potential issues in advance, avoiding the risk of rework in later
stages, ultimately improving project quality and enhancing efficiency.

案例：上海青浦印象青城項目
Case: Shanghai Qingpu Yinxiang Qingcheng Project

上海青浦印象青城項目是本集團的超低能耗建築示範項目。該項目設計屋面傳熱系數為 0.29 W/(m2 · K)，
採用一體化保溫與內保溫組合的外牆形式，使外牆平均傳熱系數控制在 0.4 W/(m2 · K) 以下；同時應用隔
熱鋁合金外窗型材和耐久性良好的暖邊間隔條，控制外窗整窗傳熱系數 K ≤ 1.4W/(m2 · K)，進一步提升該
項目外圍護結構的保溫隔熱性能。通過系統性設計，該項目外窗氣密性達到 8 級、水密性達到 6 級、空氣
聲隔聲性能達到 3 級，同時其玻璃遮陽系數≥ 0.6，可見光透射比≥ 0.4，使得該項目住宅建築本體節能率達
15%，綜合節能率達 40%。

The Shanghai Qingpu Yinxiang Qingcheng Project is the Group’s demonstration project for ultra-low energy
buildings. The project’s design specifies a roof thermal transmittance (U-value) of 0.29 W/(m² · K). It utilises a
combination of integrated insulation and internal insulation for the external walls, achieving an average U-value
below 0.4 W/(m² · K). Thermally broken aluminium alloy window frames and durable warm edge spacers are
employed, ensuring the whole window U-value is ≤ 1.4W/(m² · K), thereby further enhancing the thermal
performance of the building envelope. Through systematic design, the project achieves an air permeability rating
of Level 8, a water tightness rating of Level 6, and an airborne sound insulation rating of Level 3. Additionally,
the glass has a shading coefficient (G-value) of ≥ 0.6 and a visible light transmittance of ≥ 0.4. These measures
result in a building energy efficiency rate of 15% for the residential fabric itself and an overall comprehensive
energy efficiency rate of 40%.

 案例：北京觀雲項目
 Case: Beijing Guanyun Project

 本 集 團 以 北 京 觀 雲 超 低 能 耗 建 築 項 目 為 試 點，根 據《北 京 市 超 低 能 耗 居 住 建 築 設 計 標 準》                             （ DB11/
 T1655-2019）標準測算該項目運行過程的整體碳排放情況，結果顯示該項目年度綜合能耗值約為 6,329
 kWh╱（戶 · 年），碳排放強度約為 17 kgCO2e╱（m2 · 年），比國家現行《建築節能與可再生能源利用通用規範》
（GB 55015-2021）節能標準低 60% 以上。
 The Group piloted its Beijing Guanyun ultra-low energy building project by assessing its whole-life carbon
 emissions in accordance with the Beijing Design Standard for Ultra-Low Energy Residential Buildings (《北京市
 超低能耗居住建築設計標準》) (DB11/T1655-2019). The results show that the project’s annual comprehensive
 energy consumption is approximately 6,329 kWh per household, with a carbon emissions intensity of around 17
 kgCO2e per square metre per year. This represents a reduction of over 60% compared to the energy efficiency
 requirements of the current national standard, the General Code for Building Energy Efficiency and Renewable
 Energy Application (《建築節能與可再生能源利用通用規範》) (GB 55015-2021).


 案例：上海海閱首府
 Case: Shanghai Haiyue Shoufu Project

 本集團在上海海閱首府項目應用外牆保溫一體化系統，並應用擠塑聚苯乙烯泡沫塑料、斷熱鋁合金型材
 三玻兩腔低輻射中空窗等具有優良保溫性能的建材，進一步提升該項目的節能性能。根據上海市現行節
 能設計標準《居住建築節能設計標準》                        （DGJ08-205-2015）測算，該項目總計能耗約 169.33 萬 kWh，預期項
 目落成運營時每年可節約用電 65.13 萬 kWh，即節約標準煤 515.89 噸。
 For its Shanghai Haiyue Shoufu Project, the Group applied an integrated external wall insulation system and
 utilised building materials with excellent thermal properties, such as extruded polystyrene (XPS) foam and
 thermally broken aluminium-framed triple-glazed low-E windows to further enhance the energy efficiency.
 According to calculations based on Shanghai’s current energy efficiency design standard, the Design Standard
 for Energy Efficiency in Residential Buildings (《居住建築節能設計標準》) (DGJ08-205-2015), the project’s total
 predicted energy consumption is approximately 1,693,300 kWh. Upon completion and operation, it is expected
 to save approximately 651,300 kWh of electricity annually, equivalent to saving 515.89 tonnes of standard coal.


此 外，本 集 團 在 產 品 設 計 時 充 分 考 慮 項                    Furthermore, the Group fully considers optimal water resource

收、海 綿 城 市 等 設 計，進 一 步 提 升 建 築                      such as rainwater harvesting and reuse, and sponge city principles

                                                 雨水回收再利用系統
                                        Rainwater Harvesting and Reuse System

 本集團在杭州璞雲、漳州朗雲等項目設置雨水回收再利用系統，可將住宅屋頂、地面以及路面上的雨水有
 效地彙集，經淨化和過濾處理達到安全標準後，用於綠化灌溉、洗車及戶外設施清洗，滿足非飲用用水需
 求。此外，該系統有效減輕城市排水系統的壓力，減少雨水徑流可能引起的洪水風險，提升社區氣候適應
 能力。
 The Group has installed rainwater harvesting and reuse systems in projects such as Hangzhou Puyun and
 Zhangzhou Langyun. These systems effectively collect rainwater from residential rooftops, grounds, and road
 surfaces. After purification and filtration treatment to meet safety standards, the water is used for green space
 irrigation, car washing, and cleaning outdoor facilities, meeting non-potable water demands. Additionally, this
 system alleviates pressure on urban drainage networks, reduces the risk of flooding from rainwater runoff, and
 enhances community climate resilience.

                                                      海綿城市
                                                     Sponge City

本集團在漳州養雲、西湖泊月、縵雲、朗雲、璞雲等項目中採取海綿城市措施，包括透水鋪裝、下凹式綠
地、雨水花園、綠色屋頂、蓄水模塊等，實現雨水從傳統的「快速外排」模式向「滲、滯、蓄、淨、用、排」
六位一體模式的轉變，構建良性的水循環系統，進一步提升雨水資源利用率，有效改善社區微生態環境，
緩解內澇，提升小區安全韌性。
The Group has adopted sponge city measures in projects including Zhangzhou Yangyun, West Lake Boyue,
Manyun, Langyun, and Puyun. These measures include permeable pavements, sunken green spaces, rain
gardens, green roofs, and rainwater storage modules. They facilitate a shift from the traditional model of “rapid
drainage” to an integrated approach of “infiltration, retention, storage, purification, utilisation, and drainage”.
This helps establish a beneficial water cycle system, further improving rainwater utilisation rates, effectively
enhancing the community’s micro-ecological environment, mitigating waterlogging, and increasing the overall
safety and resilience of the neighbourhoods.

                                            預製混凝土疊合板
                                    Precast Concrete Composite Slabs

本集團在杭州雲棲上宸、杭州雲湧之江項目使用預製混凝土疊合板及配套技術，實現節省 80% 以上的模
板材料，極大減少木材和鋼材的消耗，並減少超過 80% 建築垃圾，顯著縮短施工工期，有效減少施工活
動對周邊環境的影響。
In projects such as Hangzhou Yunxi Shangchen and Hangzhou Yunyong Zhijiang, the Group utilised precast
concrete composite slabs and associated technologies. This resulted in savings of over 80% in formwork
materials, significantly reduced consumption of timber and steel, and a reduction of more than 80% in
construction waste. It also notably shortened construction timelines, effectively mitigating the impact of
construction activities on the surrounding environment.


                                     蒸壓輕質混凝土板（ALC 板）
                            Autoclaved Lightweight Concrete (ALC) Panels

本集團在佛山縵雲、東莞縵雲等項目使用輕質、保溫隔熱、防火的 ALC 條板作為內隔牆，替代傳統砌築工
藝，有效減少施工工期，並保障建築物結構安全和人員安全。
In projects like Foshan Manyun and Dongguan Manyun, the Group employed lightweight, thermally insulating,
and fire-resistant ALC panels as internal partition walls, replacing traditional masonry techniques. This approach
effectively reduced construction timelines while ensuring the structural integrity and safety of the buildings and
their occupants.

踐行低碳運營                                 Low-Carbon Operation Practices
踐行低碳運營不僅是企業降本增效的內                      Low-Carbon operation practices are not only an inherent
在 要 求，更 是 履 行 環 境 公 民 責 任 的 實 質        requirement for the Group to enhance efficiency and reduce costs,

水污染防治法》和《中華人民共和國大氣                     citizenship responsibilities. The Group strictly abides by the Law

應對氣候變化                                       Addressing Climate Change
氣候變化已成為全球面臨的嚴峻挑戰，                            Climate change has become a severe global challenge and
亦是關乎企業可持續發展的核心議題。                            is also a core issue relating to the sustainable development
本 集 團 積 極 響 應 國 家「 2030 碳 達 峰，               of enterprises. In response to the national strategic goal of
2060 碳 中 和」戰 略 目 標，將 氣 候 風 險 納               “achieving carbon peak by 2030 and carbon neutrality by 2060”,
入 企 業 戰 略 考 量，持 續 優 化 氣 候 治 理 架              the Group incorporates climate risks into its corporate strategic
構，全 面 識 別 並 評 估 氣 候 相 關 風 險 與 機              considerations, continuously optimises its climate governance
遇，部 署 適 應 性 氣 候 行 動，致 力 於 打 造                structure, comprehensively identifies and assesses climate-related
具有氣候韌性的可持續發展企業。                              risks and opportunities, and deploys climate adaptation actions,
                                             striving to building a climate-resilient, sustainable enterprise.

管治                                           Governance
本集團高度重視氣候變化帶來的挑戰和                            The Group places great emphasis on the challenges and
機遇，已建立自上而下、權責清晰的「董                           opportunities brought by climate change and has established
事 會 — ESG 工 作 小 組」兩 級 ESG 管 治 架              a top-down two-tier ESG governance structure comprising the
構，並 將 氣 候 變 化 納 入 集 團 ESG 管 治 的              “Board — ESG Working Group” with clear accountability. Climate
核 心 議 題，促 進 應 對 氣 候 變 化 相 關 事 宜              change was integrated into the Group’s core ESG governance
的有序開展。有關 ESG 管治的詳情，請參                        agenda to facilitate the orderly execution of climate change-
閱本報告「董事會聲明」小節。                               related matters. For details on ESG governance, please refer to
                                             the section headed “Statement of the Board of Directors” of the
                                             Report.

及 其 潛 在 的 財 務 影 響，並 積 極 採 取 舉 措              with their potential financial implications, and has actively taken
應對。                                          measures to address them.

風險管理                                                          Risk Management
為 構 建 系 統 化 的 氣 候 風 險 管 理 能 力，本                               To establish a systematic climate risk management capability, the
集團參考香港聯交所《環境、社會及管治                                            Group has integrated climate-related risks into its enterprise-wide
框架下氣候信息披露的實施指引》，將氣                                            risk management mechanism, forming a closed-loop management
候相關風險納入企業整體風險管理機制，                                            process with reference to the Implementation Guidance for

                                          管理層測評及溝通機制
                            Management evaluation and communication mechanism

 • 定期舉辦管理層 360°考核測評，收集員工對其所在公司團隊建設和管理層品德作風、團隊管理等多維
   度的評價與建議；
   We regularly hold 360° assessment and evaluation for management to collect employees’ multi-dimensional
   comments and suggestions on team building, management ethics and style, team management, etc.;
 • 不定期組織管理層及員工訪談，加強溝通。
   Management and employee interviews are conducted on an ad hoc basis to strengthen communication.


                                      試用期管理溝通機制
                Management communication mechanism during the probationary period

 • 為新員工設立導師，並建立「1-3-6」試用期面談機制，即分別在員工入職第 1、3、6 個月時，組織員工、
   導師、分管領導等人員進行面談，關心新員工的工作狀態和心態，同時收集新員工的建議。
   We assign mentors to new employees and establish a “1-3-6” probation interview mechanism, arranging
   interviews in the first, third, and sixth months of employment with the employee, mentor, and responsible
   leader to understand the new employee’s work status and mindset, and to gather their feedback.


                                                    高級管理層面談
                                             Senior management interviews

 • 組織集團聘任試用期內的管理人員與集團高級管理層進行面談，了解一線工作開展情況及人員適應情況；
   We organise interviews between newly appointed managers during their probationary period and the
   Group’s senior management to understand frontline work progress and their adaptation;
 • 根據需要不定期組織管理人員、員工與高級管理層進行面談交流，促進團隊融合。
   If necessary, the Company will organise management and employees to conduct interviews and exchanges
   with the Company’s management team from time to time to promote team integration.


                                                    工作會議機制
                                             Working meeting mechanism

 • 設有定期╱非定期工作會議機制，並視議題需要安排管理層及員工參加。該機制通過現場面對面會議、
   視頻會議等溝通方式決策集團經營事項。
   The Group has established a regular/non-regular working meeting mechanism and arranges management
   and employees to attend the meetings when necessary. The mechanism makes decisions on the Group’s
   operational matters through face-to-face meetings and video conferences.

案例：「領將計劃」賦能核心幹部
Case:“General Leadership Programme”Empowers Core Managers

2025 年 3 月 –10 月，為應對複雜多變的市場環境和行業挑戰，賦能幹部隊伍，本集團開展「領將計劃」幹部
培訓，57 名核心管理幹部（集團總監、職能總、一級單位班子、二級單位總經理等）參訓。培訓內容聚焦
行業洞察、經營管理、團隊管理、自我提升四模塊，結合訓前測評、課堂學習、班級活動、標桿企業參訪
以及結業答辯等多種形式，旨在拓寬管理視野，提升戰略經營能力。
From March to October 2025, in response to the complex and ever-changing market environment and industry
challenges, the Group launched the “General Leadership Programme”, a management training initiative
designed to empower our management team. A total of 57 core management personnel, including Group
Directors, Functional Heads, members of the management teams of first-tier units, and general managers of
second-tier units, participated in the training. The programme focused on four key areas: industry insights,
operation management, team management, and self-enhancement. Combining various learning methods
such as pre-training assessments, classroom learning, class activities, visits to benchmark enterprises and a
final project presentation, the programme aims to broaden the management vision and enhance the strategic
operation capabilities of participants.

 案例：工程建造體系現場教學
 Case: On-site Training on Construction System

 2025 年 8 月，為促進工程條線核心人員理解並掌握集團新發佈的建造體系相關指引，本集團組織各事業
 部工程分管及項目總等總計 27 人開展現場教學。通過實地觀摩、正反面案例解析及落地指引講解，強化
 標準落地，促進優秀經驗的復用和推廣。
 In August 2025, to facilitate the understanding and mastery of the Group’s newly released guidelines on the
 construction system among core personnel of the engineering sector, the Group organised on-site training
 for a total of 27 participants, including the engineering management leaders of various business divisions
 and project managers. Through site visits, analysis of both positive and negative cases, and explanations of
 implementation guidelines, the Group aims to reinforce the implementation of standards and promote the reuse
 and dissemination of outstanding experiences.

 案例：2025 屆管培生培訓
 Case: 2025 Management Trainee Training

 2025 年 7 月，本集團各板塊 168 位管培生在廈門參加了為期 6 天的入職集訓。通過團隊拓展、課程學習、
 實地參訪、交流分享等環節，幫助管培生深植企業文化、熟悉業務體系、加速融入團隊，為公司高質量發
 展注入新生力量。
 In July 2025, 168 management trainees from various business segments of the Group participated in a six-
 day onboarding camp in Xiamen. Through team-building activities, training courses, site visits, and sharing
 sessions, the training helped management trainees deepen their understanding of corporate culture, familiarise
 themselves with business operations, and accelerate their integration into their teams, thereby injecting new
 impetus into the Company’s high-quality development.

Case: AI Empowerment, Enlightening the Future — AI Bootcamp

2025 年 5 月，本集團舉辦第一期 AI 實戰營，共計 750 餘名員工參訓。培訓聚焦「AI 高效辦公六大實戰技能」，

training focused on “Six Core AI Skills for Efficient Office Work”, centred around common office scenarios and
adopted an integrated “learning, practising, and applying” model, which effectively enhanced the employees’
ability to utilise intelligent tools to solve practical problems.

 員工培訓考核機制
 Employee Training Assessment Mechanism

                         • 實行「凡培訓必考試」，設置 80 分通過線，未通過則須重新學習和補考；
                           All training sessions require examinations, with a passing score set at 80 points;
                           participants who fail the make-up examination or miss the initial examination must re-
                           study and take a supplementary examination;

                         • 培訓、考試及答辯考核結果形成檔案，作為考核晉升的重要依據。
                           Training records, examination results, and assessment presentations will be compiled into
                           individual training files, serving as important references for performance evaluation and
                           promotion decisions.

案例：尊師重教 —「桃李節」活動
Case: Respecting Teachers and Valuing Education —“Teacher Appreciation Festival”Event

2025 年 9 月 10 日，為感恩內訓師與新人指導師的辛勤付出，本集團舉辦第三屆「桃李節」系列活動。活動
以「感恩贈禮 + 外宣賦能」為主旨，通過向講師和指導師贈花和定製節日禮包傳遞謝意，並藉助宣傳視頻擴
大活動影響力，營造「樂於分享、教學相長」的組織氛圍，強化內部人才培育文化。
On 10 September 2025, to express appreciation for the dedication of internal trainers and new induction
trainers, the Group organised the third “Teacher Appreciation Festival” event. Centered around the theme of
“Gratitude Gifts + External Publicity Empowerment”, the event expressed appreciation to trainers and mentors
through the presentation of flowers and customised festive gift packages. Meanwhile, promotional videos were
used to amplify the event’s influence, fostering an organisational culture of “willingness to share and mutual
growth through teaching”, and reinforcing the culture of internal talent development.

 案例：「安全生產季」專項行動
 Case: Special Action on“Production Safety Season”

 2025 年 7 月至 9 月，本集團開展「安全生產季」主題活動，緊扣「保安全、查隱患、防災害」主題，要求項目
 進行安全隱患「日查日糾」，並限定 24 小時內（普通問題）完成閉環。活動期間設置安全知識打卡環節，約
 2 萬員工參與，營造了「人人講安全、人人踐行安全」的良好氛圍。
 From July to September 2025, the Group launched a thematic initiative entitled “Production Safety Season”,
 focusing on the core themes of “ensuring safety, identifying hazards, and preventing disasters”. The programme
 required projects to conduct daily hazard inspections and corrective actions, with a mandate to complete closed-
 loop resolution of general issues within 24 hours. During the campaign, a safety knowledge check-in segment
 was introduced, attracting the participation of approximately 20,000 employees, thereby fostering a positive
 atmosphere in which “everyone prioritises safety and everyone practises safety”.

案例：「跑贏 2025 · 新春第一跑」活動
Case:“Race Ahead 2025 • First Spring Run”Event

2025 年 2 月，本集團開展「跑贏 2025 · 新春第一跑」活動，共 25 支隊伍、400 多位夥伴們集結在廈門五緣灣
感恩廣場，能量滿滿地開啟新一年的征程！活動跑沿途設置 5 個闖關打卡點，通過知識答題、做遊戲等方
式增強跑步的趣味性，營造人人參與、全民健身的工作氛圍。
In February 2025, the Group organised the “Race Ahead 2025 · First Spring Run” activity, with 25 teams
comprising more than 400 comrades gathering at Xiamen Wuyuan Bay Thanksgiving Square to commence the
journey of the new year with full energy! Along the running route, 5 checkpoints with fun challenges were set
up to enhance the fun of running through tasks such as quizzes and games, fostering a working atmosphere of
all-round participation and nationwide fitness.

 案例：第三屆歌手大賽
 Case: The Third Singer Competition

 為豐富員工精神文化生活，本集團於 2025 年舉辦「第三屆歌手大賽」。賽事在常規歌手賽基礎上，增設原
 創音樂創作賽道，鼓勵員工進行歌詞旋律創作，以音樂語言講述自身故事。活動得到廣大員工的積極響應，
 充分展現了員工昂揚向上的精神風貌與多元才藝風采，為本集團 45 周年華誕獻上獨具匠心的「聲」動賀禮。
 To enrich the spiritual and cultural life of its employees, the Group organised the “Third Singer Competition” in
 2025. Based on the regular singing contest, this event added an original music composition track to encourage
 employees to create lyrics and melodies and tell their own stories through music. The event received full and
 active responses from employees, fully showcasing their uplifting spirit and diverse talents, and served as a truly
 unique and heartfelt tribute to the Group’s 45th anniversary.

案例：「我為建發代言」宣講比賽
Case:“Be the Spokesperson for C&D”Presentation Competition

為強化青年員工人文關懷，凝聚青年力量，本集團搭建青年員工專屬交流展示平台，全方位賦能青年成長。
2025 年，本集團開展以「好房子、好品質、好服務」為核心主題的宣講比賽，引導青年員工從日常工作細
微之處發現價值、挖掘亮點，通過誦讀、脫口秀、歌曲改編、情景演繹等豐富形式的活動內容，充分展現
青年員工精神風貌。活動有效搭建了青年員工交流互動與自我展示的平台，實現人文關懷與文化傳承的
有機融合，助力青年員工與企業同發展、共進步。
To strengthen humanistic care for young employees and unite the strength of the youth, the Group has
established a dedicated platform for young employees to exchange ideas and showcase themselves,
empowering their growth in all aspects. In 2025, the Group organised a presentation competition under the
core theme of “Quality Homes, Quality Living, Quality Services” ( 好 房 子、好 品 質、好 服 務 ), guiding young
employees to discover value and identify highlights in their daily work. Through various forms of activities
such as recitations, stand-up comedy, song adaptations and situational performances, the competition fully
demonstrated the spirit and outlook of the young employees. The event effectively built a platform for young
employees to interact and present themselves, achieving an organic integration of humanistic care and cultural
inheritance, and helping young employees grow and progress together with the Company.

 案例：「暖心助困」捐助
 Case:“Warmth and Support”Donation Campaigns

 2025 年，本集團參與基金「暖心助困」捐助活動，向廈門地區 314 戶困難戶發放慰問金人民幣 31.4 萬元，
 並投入人民幣 13.3 萬元資助 311 戶困難戶年夜飯。
 In 2025, the Group participated in the “Warmth and Support” donation campaigns organised by the Fund,
 distributing a total of RMB314,000 in relief funds to 314 disadvantaged households in Xiamen and investing
 RMB133,000 to sponsor New Year’s Eve meals for 311 disadvantaged households.

 2025 年 3 月，本集團同步參與基金「定向恤病」捐助活動，向廈門地區 1 名罹患重大疾病困難戶發放慰問金
 人民幣 5 萬元，幫助困難群眾救治重病以渡過難關。
 In March 2025, the Group also participated in the “Medical Assistance” donation activity organised by the Fund,
 granting RMB50,000 in consolation money to an underprivileged household with a member suffering from a
 critical illness in Xiamen, helping the patient overcome difficulties by receiving treatment for a serious disease.

案例：「雨潤青苗」助孤
Case:“Yurun Qingmiao（雨潤青苗）”Support for Orphaned and Underprivileged Children

2025 年 6 月，本集團參與基金「雨潤青苗」結對幫扶慈善助學活動，為廈門各區 130 名孤困兒童提供人民幣
32.5 萬元的資金幫助，並組織入戶慰問，傳遞愛心與溫暖。此外，本集團依託「雲潤青苗」項目，資助雲洋
小學困難家庭學生 3 戶。
In June 2025, the Group participated in the “Yurun Qingmiao ( 雨 潤 青 苗 )” paired education assistance
programme organised by the Fund, providing RMB325,000 in financial support to 130 orphaned and
underprivileged children in various districts of Xiamen. The Group also organised home visits to extend care
and warmth. In addition, under the “Yurun Qingmiao ( 雨潤青苗 )” programme, the Group provided financial
assistance to three students from underprivileged families at Yunyang Primary School.


報告期內，本集團累計投入資金人民幣 42.1 萬元，共計扶助 168 名學齡人士。
During the Reporting Period, the Group contributed a total of RMB421,000 in funding, supporting 168 school-
age individuals.

 案例：「有愛就有路 · 讓夢前行」助學
 Case:“Where There Is Love, There Is a Way — Let Dreams Take Flight”Education Support Programme

 2025 年 8 月，本集團參與基金「有愛就有路 · 讓夢前行」慈善助學暨公益捐書活動，資助廈門 110 名應屆及
 在校貧困大學生，共計人民幣 60.5 萬元，幫助他們完成學業。同時，本集團依託「讓夢前行」項目，資助雲
 洋村 4 戶困難家庭大學生人民幣 2 萬元，供其追逐學業夢想。
 In August 2025, the Group participated in the “Where There Is Love, There Is a Way — Let Dreams Take Flight”
 education support and book donation campaign organised by the Fund, providing financial support totalling
 RMB605,000 to 110 university students in Xiamen, including recent graduates and current students from low-
 income families, helping them complete their studies. In addition, the Group, through the “Let Dreams Take
 Flight” programme, supported four university students from needy families in Yunyang Village with RMB20,000
 to assist them in pursuing their educational aspirations.


 同月，針對廈門市海滄區新垵公益圖書館因暴雨受災、上千本圖書被毀的情況，本集團黨員志願者聯動業
 主志願服務隊，迅速募集 3,500 多本書籍、155 件益智玩具以及 3 台電腦，助力圖書館重建，並組織受資助
 大學生共同開展志願服務活動，形成愛心循環。
 In the same month, in response to the flooding that damaged the Xin’an Charity Library in Haicang District,
 Xiamen, destroying thousands of books, the Group’s Party member volunteers, together with the property
 owner volunteer service team, swiftly mobilised resources to donate over 3,500 books, 155 educational toys and
 three computers to aid in the library’s reconstruction. The Group also organised sponsored university students to
 participate in volunteer activities, fostering a virtuous cycle of compassion.

案例：同安雲洋村農特產品產業幫扶
Case: Agricultural Product Industry Support in Yunyang Village, Tong’an

本集團通過「以買代幫」及舉辦公益集市等形式，打通農產品銷售渠道。報告期內，本集團助力雲洋村售
出特色農產品手工麵線超 7,400 件，推動村財政增收超人民幣 42 萬元，以實際行動踐行企業擔當。
The Group opened up sales channels for agricultural products through “purchase-as-assistance initiatives” and
charity markets. During the Reporting Period, the Group facilitated the sale of over 7,400 units of specialty
agricultural products (handmade noodles) from Yunyang Village, generating an additional fiscal revenue of over
RMB420,000 for the village, thereby demonstrating its commitment to corporate responsibility through concrete
actions.

 案例：廈門市同文頂片區煥發新生
 Case: Renovation and Upgrade of Tongwending Area in Xiamen Old Town

 本集團積極推進廈門市舊城區同文頂片區改造提升項目。針對片區基礎設施老化、居住環境擁擠、功能佈
 局不合理等痛點，本集團在設計中深度融合舊城記憶，採用系統性更新提升的方式，全面煥新居住環境，
 提升當地居民生活幸福感。該項目實現了歷史人文底蘊傳承與現代生活需求的有機統一，為區域經濟社
 會可持續發展賦能，也為廈門市老城區樹立優質範本。


 The Group has actively promoted the renovation and upgrade project in the Tongwending area of Xiamen
 old town. In response to key challenges within the area, including ageing infrastructure, overcrowded living
 environments, and an unreasonable functional layout, the Group has integrated the memory of the old
 town into the design and adopted a systematic approach of renovation and upgrading to comprehensively
 rejuvenate the living environment and enhance the well-being of local residents. This project has achieved an
 organic unification of inheriting the area’s rich history and culture with meeting modern living needs, thereby
 empowering the sustainable economic and social development of the region and establishing a high-quality
 benchmark for Xiamen’s old city district.

     預期。                                  reasonable under the circumstances.

        使用權資產指中國的土地及辦公                                          The right-of-use assets represented leases of lands and
        室租賃。中國的辦公室租賃通常初                                         offices in the PRC. The leases of offices in the PRC typically
        步為期 2 至 20 年。概無租賃包含可                                    run for an initial period of 2 to 20 years. None of the leases
        變租賃款項。若干租賃包含在合約                                         includes variable lease payments. Certain leases include an
        期限結束後將租賃續期的額外選                                          option to renew the lease for an additional period after
        擇權。本集團於租賃開始日期評估                                         the end of the contract term. The Group assesses at lease
        是否合理確定行使續租選擇權，並                                         commencement date whether it is reasonably certain to
        斷定並非合理確定行使續租選擇                                          exercise the extension options and concluded that it is
        權。因此，續租期間的未來租賃款                                         not reasonably certain to exercise the extension options.
        項不計入使用權資產計量。                                            Accordingly, the future lease payments during the extension
                                                                periods are not included in the measurement of the right-
                                                                of-use assets.

        根據租賃期有關租賃土地的使用                                          The analysis of the net carrying amounts of right-of-use
        權資產賬面淨值分析如下：                                            assets in respect of the leasehold lands according to lease
                                                                periods are as follows:

                                                                                               二零二五年           二零二四年
                                                                                                   2025            2024

       響。                               in market interest rates.

       款、計 息 借 款、向 間 接 控 股              borrowings, loans from intermediate holding

       本集團面臨現金流量利率風                     except for loans to associates, loans to joint ventures,

   43.6 流動資金風險                      43.6 Liquidity risk
       流動資金風險指本集團未能                      Liquidity risk relates to the risk that the Group will
       履行以交付現金或其他金融                      not be able to meet its obligations associated with
       資產結算金融負債相關責任                      its financial liabilities that are settled by delivering
       的風險。本集團在清償貿易                      cash or other financial assets. The Group is exposed
       及其他應付款項、應付關連                      to liquidity risk in respect of settlement of trade and
       公司款項、應付非控股權益                      other payables, amounts due to related companies,
       款項、間接控股公司貸款、                      amounts due to non-controlling interests, loans
       計息借款、租賃負債以及其                      from intermediate holding company, interest-
       履行融資責任方面及在現金                      bearing borrowings, lease liabilities and its financing
       流量管理方面承擔流動資金                      obligation, and also in respect of its cash flow
       風險。本集團的目的是將流                      management. The Group’s objective is to maintain
       動資產及承諾融資維持於適                      an appropriate level of liquid assets and committed
       當水平，以應付其短期及較                      lines of funding to meet its liquidity requirements in
       長期流動資金需求。                         the short and longer term.

       本集團透過謹慎監控長期                       The Group manages its liquidity needs on a
       金融負債的還款期及預測                       consolidated basis by carefully monitoring scheduled
       日常業務現金流入及流出，                      debt servicing payments for long term financial
       以綜合基準管理其流動資金                      liabilities as well as forecast cash inflows and
       需要。流動資金需要按不同                      outflows due in day to day business. Liquidity needs
       時段監察，包括按日及按星                      are monitored in various time bands, on a day to
       期，以及按 30 日滾存預測。                   day and week to week basis, as well as on the basis
       180 日 及 360 日 監 察 期 的 長           of a rolling 30-day projection. Long term liquidity
       期流動資金需求乃每月釐                       needs for a 180-day and 360-day lookout period
       定。現金淨額需要與可動用                      are identified monthly. Net cash requirements are
       借貸融資比較，以釐定空間                      compared to available borrowing facilities in order to
       或任何差額。此分析顯示預                      determine headroom or any shortfalls. This analysis
       期可動用借貸融資於監察期                      shows if available borrowing facilities are expected to
       間是否充足。                            be sufficient over the lookout period.

       本集團維持現金及短期銀行                      The Group maintains cash and short-term bank
       存 款 以 應 付 其 最 少 30 日 的            deposits to meet its liquidity requirements for 30
       流動資金需要。應付較長期                      day periods at a minimum. Funding for longer-term
       流動資金需要的資金已透過                      liquidity needs is additionally secured by an adequate
       保持充足承諾信貸融資額度                      amount of committed credit facilities and the ability
       及出售較長期金融資產的能                      to sell longer-term financial assets.
       力作出額外擔保。
